# stb_image

Vendored copy of [stb_image.h](https://github.com/nothings/stb) from the official repository.

- Single-header image loader (PNG, JPEG, and other formats).
- Used privately by the engine for `Texture2D` (implementation only).
- `STB_IMAGE_IMPLEMENTATION` is defined in `OpenGLTexture2D.cpp`.

Refresh from upstream when you intentionally bump the vendored version.
